definition_en: a harmless substance given as if it were medicine, or something that comforts without real effect
core_image: 临床试验里，对照组拿到的是没有药效的糖片，却报告症状减轻
scene: 对照组吃的是糖做的安慰剂，却也有不少人说疼痛缓解了。The control group took a sugar placebo, and many still reported less pain.
sceneCN: 这里指「安慰剂」（第 1 个义项：没有药效、却当作药物给出的东西）；句意：对照组吃的是糖做的安慰剂，仍有很多人说疼痛减轻了。

senses.title: Inert treatment
senses.definition: a substance with no active ingredient given to a patient
senses.definitionCN: 给病人的、不含有效成分的制剂
senses.example: Half the volunteers received a placebo instead of the drug.
senses.exampleCN: 一半志愿者服用的是安慰剂而非药物。
senses.why: The Latin word means I shall please; the name was given to treatments that satisfy the patient rather than cure.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语原意是「我将使人满意」；这个名字给了那些只让病人安心、并不治病的处理方式。

senses.title: The effect itself
senses.definition: the improvement that comes from believing one is treated
senses.definitionCN: 因为相信自己被治疗而产生的改善
senses.example: The placebo effect explains part of the recovery in both groups.
senses.exampleCN: 安慰剂效应解释了对照组与用药组都有的一部分好转。
senses.why: Belief changes symptoms, so the inert substance produces a measurable response.
senses.whyCN: 信念会改变症状，于是这种无活性物质也产生了可测的反应。

senses.title: Comforting substitute
senses.definition: anything that comforts without solving the problem
senses.definitionCN: 任何起安抚作用却没有解决问题的东西
senses.example: Promises without funding are a placebo for the neighbourhood.
senses.exampleCN: 没有拨款配套的承诺，对社区只是空头安慰。
senses.why: The medical sense spreads to everyday language as a label for hollow comfort.
senses.whyCN: 医学义扩散到日常语言，成为「空洞安慰」的标签。

intro.en: Placebo is Latin for I shall please, from placere, to please.
intro.cn: placebo 是拉丁语「我将使人满意」，来自 placere（使满意）。

items.en: Placebo is the future form of placere, to please.
items.cn: placebo 是 placere（使满意）的将来时形式。

items.en: It appears in the Latin psalter as a pleasing line.
items.cn: 它出现在拉丁语诗篇里，指一句讨喜的话。

items.en: Medicine borrows the word for treatments given to gratify patients.
items.cn: 医学借这个词指只为让病人满意的处理。

items.en: Controlled trials turn it into a standard comparison arm.
items.cn: 对照试验把它变成标准对照臂。

items.en: Everyday speech uses it for hollow comfort.
items.cn: 日常语言用它指空头安慰。

note.en: Placebo sits beside nocebo, control, and sham treatment.
note.cn: placebo 与 nocebo、control、sham treatment 相邻。

entries.definition: a harmless substance that causes harm through belief
entries.definitionCN: 因信念而产生不适的无害物质

entries.definition: the comparison group in an experiment

normalIntro.en: Placebo is Latin for I shall please: it pleases rather than cures.
normalIntro.cn: placebo 是拉丁语「我将使人满意」：它让人安心，而非治好病。

normal.en: Trials compare the drug against a placebo.
normal.cn: 试验把药物与安慰剂作对照。

normal.en: The placebo group improved almost as much as the treated group.
normal.cn: 安慰剂组的好转几乎与用药组相当。

normal.en: Some trials are double blind and placebo controlled.
normal.cn: 有些试验是双盲、安慰剂对照的。

normal.en: Researchers study the placebo effect carefully.
normal.cn: 研究者仔细研究安慰剂效应。

normal.en: Compare nocebo: belief can also make people feel worse.
normal.cn: 对比 nocebo：信念也能让人更难受。

abstract.en: Picture a sugar pill in a medicine bottle.
abstract.cn: 想象药瓶里装的是糖片。

abstract.en: Imagine a patient feeling better after a tablet with no active ingredient.
abstract.cn: 想象病人吃了没有有效成分的药片却好转。

abstract.en: Think of a promise with no budget behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象一个背后没有预算的承诺。

examples.en: The trial gave one group the drug and the other a placebo.
examples.cn: 试验给一组用药、另一组用安慰剂。

examples.en: Her improvement was put down to the placebo effect.
examples.cn: 她的好转被归因于安慰剂效应。

examples.en: Funding cuts left the programme as a placebo for real reform.
examples.cn: 经费削减让这个项目成了真正改革的安慰剂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「place + bo」——给你一个「放得下」的东西，让你心里安稳；只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 placere（使满意）→ 将来式 placebo（我将使人满意）→ 医学 placebo（安慰剂），核心义「让人安心而非治病」。

sensesIntro.en: Placebo first means the inert treatment, then the effect it produces, then hollow comfort in general.
sensesIntro.cn: placebo 先指无药效的制剂，再指它带来的效应，最后泛指空头安慰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pill with no medicine that still makes someone feel better.
core.cn: 核心意象：没有药效的药片，却仍让人感觉好转。

branches.en: The inert treatment is the medical sense.
branches.cn: 无药效制剂是医学义项。

branches.en: The effect is what belief produces.
branches.cn: 效应是信念带来的结果。

branches.en: Hollow comfort is the everyday extension.
A treatment and its effect are studied together.
branches.cn: 制剂与效应总是一起研究。

branches.en: Both rest on belief rather than substance.
branches.cn: 两者都靠信念而非实质。

intro.en: Placebo comes from the Latin pleasing verb placere.
intro.cn: placebo 来自拉丁语「使满意」动词 placere。

latinIntro.en: Latin placere gives placebo, please, pleasant, and complacent.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 placere 给出 placebo、please、pleasant、complacent。

items.example: Placebo is a verb form turned noun.
items.exampleCN: placebo 是动词形式转成的名词。

items.example: Please descends from the same verb.

items.exampleCN: pleasant 共享「使人满意」的意思。
这个复合词为现象命名。
